blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: half adder — Combinational circuit that adds two one-bit inputs.
full adder — Adds two bits and a carry-in bit.
CarryOut — Bit passed to the next higher column.
D flip-flop — Clock-triggered circuit that stores one bit.

blocks.title: Find the Sum bit
blocks.text: XOR is 1 when A and B are different; A=1, B=1 gives Sum=0.

blocks.title: Find the Carry bit
blocks.text: AND is 1 only when both inputs are 1; here Carry=1.

blocks.title: Extend to full adder and memory
blocks.text: A full adder also includes CarryIn. Unlike combinational logic, a D flip-flop stores a bit until the triggering clock edge.
